contract.supported_ir_domain: DecodedExecution values for which decodeBytes succeeds, types enumerations are nonempty finite, state table is complete |domains|×|parties|×|assets| nonnegative cells in declaration order, registry ids unique, and step tags are invoke|issue|revoke
contract.canonicality_hypothesis: RatEnc lowest terms den>0; objects use grammar canonical_nested_key_order plus lexicographic UTF-8 fallback; compact UTF-8 with no extra whitespace; no duplicate keys
contract.extensional_finite_world_equality: worldEq cells amounts and store.entries pointwise; not function extensionality over an infinite Domain

kernel_versus_report_policy.rule: Raw kernel/decoded-execution correspondence does not imply Report.status. Successful Typed.execute or Composition.executeStep/run is a kernel projection. Report.accepted requires that kernel projection plus justified policy premises. Do not assume the desired Report constructor from kernel success.
policy_premises_in_order: source_identity: envelope source_pin.git/lean_toolchain/mathlib_rev equal delivered dependency records at D
six_class_presence: all six assumption classes present and labelled
claimed_world_agreement: claimed_next_state is null or worldEq the recomputed post ExecutionResultEnc
precedence: decodeBytes codec malformed/blocked never reach kernel or Report
mode routing: only DecodedExecution is a checkIR input
source_identity mismatch: staleSource; kernel not invoked; world is pre
claimed_world_agreement: on kernel ok, mismatch is observationMismatch.claimedNextState; world and receipt are the successful recomputation
six_class_presence: missing required class is incompleteObligation; world/receipt retain the kernel result
Report.accepted only if kernel ok and all three policy premises hold and unsupported is null and required reached families are true
kernel_versus_report_policy.does_not_discharge_P20: Quantified proofs of the statements below remain P20. Finite F25/F36/F37/F41/F27/F28 checks are bounded evidence only.

projections.located_failure: cursorFailure = {index, step (null at startCursor configuration else the refused Step), reason: FailurePath}

statements.name: encode_decode_roundtrip
statements.statement: ∀ (ir : DecodedIR), supported ir → canonical ir → decodeBytes (encodeModule ir) = .ok ir

statements.name: decode_encode_canonical_bytes
statements.statement: ∀ raw ir, decodeBytes raw = .ok ir → canonical ir → encodeModule ir = raw. Decode accepts exactly the compact canonical form (declared nested key order, lexicographic UTF-8 fallback, no extra whitespace). Non-canonical key order or extra whitespace is DecodeFailure, not a second accepted representative.

statements.name: checkIR_kernel_execute_ok
statements.statement: ∀ cert ir post, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir is DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → Typed.execute ir.registry ir.store ir.ctx ir.env ir.now ir.request ir.state = .ok post → kernelProjection(checkIR ir).world worldEq post ∧ kernelProjection(checkIR ir).receipt = invoked ir.request (extractEvaluated ir pre). This does not imply (checkIR ir).status = .accepted.

statements.name: checkIR_report_accepted_from_kernel_and_policy
statements.statement: ∀ ir post, kernel execute/step/run ok post → source_identity(ir) → six_class_presence(ir) → claimed_world_agreement(ir, post) → unsupported ir = none → required reached families true → (checkIR ir).status = .accepted ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world post. Each conjunct is an explicit premise; kernel success alone is not this theorem.

statements.name: checkIR_claimed_next_state_mismatch
statements.statement: ∀ ir post, Typed.execute ... = .ok post → claimed_next_state present → ¬ worldEq claimed_next_state post → (checkIR ir).status = .refused ∧ (checkIR ir).failure = observationMismatch.claimedNextState ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world post ∧ receipt retained from the successful invoke. F25 and F36 may share the identical kernel payload.

statements.name: checkIR_kernel_execute_error
statements.statement: ∀ ir r, decodeBytes cert.raw = .ok ir → ir is DecodedExecution → ir.mode = typed-execute → Typed.execute ... = .error r → kernelProjection(checkIR ir).failure = kernel r ∧ worldEq (checkIR ir).world ir.preState ∧ (checkIR ir).receipt = none. Report.status is .refused when policy has already passed source identity; this statement does not by itself fix status under staleSource.

statements.name: checkIR_kernel_executeStep_ok
statements.statement: ir.mode = composition-step → ir is DecodedExecution → Composition.executeStep ... = .ok result → kernelProjection world/receipt/outputs equal result. Does not imply Report.accepted without T-report-policy-accepted premises.

statements.name: checkIR_kernel_executeStep_error
statements.statement: executeStep = .error f → kernelProjection failure is the wrapped FailurePath of f ∧ worldEq pre ∧ receipt = none ∧ outputs = []. Policy fields are not cursor fields.

statements.name: checkIR_run_cursor_projection
statements.statement: ir.mode = composition-run → let c := Composition.run ... in kernelProjection(checkIR ir) equals {world := c.world, events := c.events, outputs := c.outputs, nextIndex := c.nextIndex, cursorFailure := c.failure mapped to FailurePath}. Report.status, judgments, assumptions, outstanding, source_pin, audit_roots and unsupported are report-only policy fields and are not cursor fields. Proofs remain P20.

statements.name: decode_error_no_execute
statements.statement: decodeBytes raw = malformed/blocked → checkBytes raw is codec outcome and Typed.execute / executeStep / run are not called

contract.bounded_if_not_proved: If a statement is only computationally checked on fixtures, label it bounded and do not use it to discharge universal RC01 or P20.

R1.finding: F37 source_identity precheck leaves world pre/receipt null; T-kernel-execute-ok nonetheless demands post world and invoked receipt from kernelProjection(checkIR ir). Companion error/step/run claims need the same prior-domain restriction. Observation-mismatch needs prior source_identity. Accepted policy must explicitly include requested library/invariant discharge checks from result algebra.

stage_order_typed_execute: evaluation.template.evaluate (prior class; not a family-false unless Args.check)
aggregation.combine_one_command: Family F is false if any reached F-stage failed. Family F is not_reached if zero F-stages were reached. Family F is not_applicable if the command kind never has F. Family F is true if at least one F-stage was reached, every reached F-stage succeeded, and unreached later F-stages are not evaluated merely to fill an outcome.
aggregation.combine_run: Walk attempts in order. A later inert suffix is not evaluated. Family F is false if any reached attempt's F is false. Successful-prefix true does not justify a later failed attempt's conjunct (F49 insufficientFunds makes accountingCorrect false). compositionCompatible remains true when catalog/run machinery ran and the failure is a kernel family.
aggregation.insufficientFunds_family: accountingCorrect (nonnegative post-balance conjunct). Do not call accountingOK after that failure.
aggregation.evaluation_missingObservation_family: prior class after invoke; typeCorrect is Args.check (true if that passed); authorityCorrect true if invoke passed; footprint/accounting not_reached
